failure.diagnosis: The Command Center primary Nemotron request exhausted its historical 60-second intelligence timeout during cold-start inference, then followed the implemented fallback path to buddy_operator. The worker itself had already passed health and listener ownership checks.

repair.strategy: Warm the exact governed Nemotron worker directly with a bounded local 300-second no-side-effect probe, transactionally set INTELLIGENCE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=300 alongside the existing Nemotron URL/model settings, recreate only Command Center, and require source=nemotron before accepting activation.
repair.rollback: The complete pre-change Command Center env remains backed up and is restored with Command Center recreation on any later failure.
